summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares under its existing share buyback program. On 24 June 2026, the issuer purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at prices between 107.55 and 108.90 pence per share (volume-weighted average 108.3071 pence). The shares will be cancelled. The buyback was announced on 30 January 2026 and is executed under the Market Abuse Regulation. No recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date is disclosed. This is a routine open-market repurchase; watch for completion of the announced buyback quantum.
